messages:
maria: Heads up — seeing a surge of KMS decrypt failures coming from the gpu-lease-controller. Large number of audit entries showing attempts to decrypt with a SA that should have been scoped down last week.

alex: :eyes: can you paste one of the audit lines? rough time/window is fine.

maria: sure, sample below (redacted):
```json
{
  "kind": "Event",
  "requestURI": "/api/v1/namespaces/default/services/secret-decrypt",
  "user": { "username": "system:serviceaccount:gpu-system:gpu-lease-sa" },
  "responseStatus": { "code": 403 },
  "annotations": { "kms.error": "accessDenied" }
}
```

sam: that SA was part of the deploy-perm consolidation PR last Thursday. my bet: a RoleBinding got aggregated into a ClusterRoleAggregate that re-added secret get/decrypt perms indirectly.

jen: oncall ran this to find bindings: `kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding -A -o yaml | rg -n \"gpu-lease-sa\"` — found 1 clusterrolebinding `deploy-legacy-global` that references `cluster-admin-ish` aggregate.

alex: if it's a clusterrolebinding we need immediate mitigation. Suggest steps: 1) remove the binding or patch to namespaced RoleBinding 2) rotate SA tokens / KMS envelope keys if we suspect exfil 3) add audit alert for any 'decrypt' denials.

maria: rolling a patch now to patch the CRB to a namespaced RoleBinding scoped to `kube-system` where the controller runs. applying via `kubectl patch clusterrolebinding deploy-legacy-global --type json -p '[{"op":"remove","path":"/subjects/1"}]'` to temporarily remove the subject.

deploy-bot: deploy started for `eng-infra/security/patch/rolebound-gpu-sa` — CI passed. :white_check_mark:

sam: also capturing the exact aggregation rules from the PR diff to avoid re-creation on next deploy. looks like `aggregate-to-deploy` included `rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1` rules that match `secrets/*` verbs. we'll tighten matching.

alex: we should also add a short e2e test in our infra repo to assert `gpu-lease-sa` cannot call KMS decrypt path. Simple curl to the control-plane endpoint verifying 403.

jen: I've created an audit log query and a Grafana alert: `sum(rate(k8s_audit_events{verb=~\"decrypt|get\", user=~\"system:serviceaccount:gpu-system.*\"}[5m])) > 5` — alerting to #eng-oncall and #eng-security.

maria: quick note on KMS: we saw no successful decrypts from that SA in the history window, so no evidence of compromise. still rotating ephemeral credentials as a precaution.

alex: long term items: 1) disallow aggregation for any rule that matches `secrets` or `kms.decrypt` by default 2) add a pre-merge linter in CI that checks for dangerous aggregates 3) add documented process for converting ClusterRoleBindings to namespaced RoleBindings for controllers in a canary rollout.

sam: opening a follow-up RFC to propose `rbac-aggregation-safe` label on ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding and a controller that enforces it. will cc infra and sec.

maria: thanks — for now the clusterrolebinding patch is live, tokens rotated, alerting on, and I'm running a re-audit across clusters. ping me if you see anything. :lock:

alex: thumbs up. once the RFC lands we'll schedule a remediation window to enforce the checks and clean up old aggregates.

jen: file an incident ticket for traceability? small outage risk during fixes but we should track.

maria: created INC-2026-0320 in the tracker, linking PRs and audit logs.

sam: added test case to infra CI and a one-time job to scan for any ClusterRoleBindings referencing SAs in `gpu-system`. job: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o jsonpath='{".items[*].subjects[*].name"}' | rg \"gpu-lease-sa\" || true`

alex: great. I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft after we confirm no successful decrypts.

maria: ok closing the thread for now, will update incident. thanks everyone. :pray:
